dj.line: A ten-thousand-fee table, and one of the two seats has no name on it at all — just zeroes where the ticker should be, the house's own coin sitting down to play. Hook's ended in c0c0, neat as a monogram. Nothing to see. Sit, or don't; the felt doesn't care either way.
